property: A request target is accepted only when it is free of percent-encoding and its canonical form is identical to the canonical form of the signed path.
reference_fix: canonicalize(request_path) is not None and canonicalize(request_path) == canonicalize(signed_path)
alternate_fixes: canonicalize(signed_path) == canonicalize(request_path) and canonicalize(request_path) is not None
not (canonicalize(request_path) is None) and canonicalize(request_path) == canonicalize(signed_path)

seeded_bad.why: Requires byte-identical request targets, refusing the encoded traversal PoC but also every legitimate duplicate-slash and dot-segment form.

seeded_bad.expression: canonicalize(request_path) is None or canonicalize(request_path) == canonicalize(signed_path)
seeded_bad.why: Treats an uncanonicalizable percent-encoded target as acceptable, so the encoded traversal is admitted.
Rejects every request target, so no legitimate signed request can be served.

seeded_bad.expression: True and (canonicalize(request_path) is None or canonicalize(request_path) == canonicalize(signed_path))
seeded_bad.why: Wraps the percent-tolerant guard in 'True and (...)', leaving encoded traversal admitted.

polarity.fact: The canonicalized request target must be equal to the canonicalized signed path; a merely different canonical form must never be accepted.
